desc: At Mossberg we know a proper fit is one of the keys to safe shooting. That's why we're dedicated to ensuring that parents, grandparents and mentors are able to provide responsible young hunters with a firearm that fits their frame properly and comfortably. The Patriot Super Bantam is perfect for all ages of smaller-statured hunter, boasting all the quality features found in our standard full-sized Patriot models, sized for a proper fit.
